judgment_text:
Prayer : Petition filed under Section 11 of Contempt of Courts Act, to punish respondent for willful disobedience of the order dated 2-4-2025 in W.A. No. 2144 of 2023

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Manindra Mohan Shrivastava, C.J.:— At the outset, learned counsel for petitioner submits that the order passed by this Court has been complied with.

2. In view of the above submission and the order that has now been passed on 5-2-2026, which was perused by us upon production by learned State Counsel, we are not inclined to proceed further. Contempt petition is closed.
